اعتذرنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَذَرْنَا (iʕtaḏarnā) /iʕ.ta.ðar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اُعْتُذِرْنَا (uʕtuḏirnā) /uʕ.tu.ðir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
